corpus:
Cedar Hollow Studio session log, Northwind Sessions track sheet, revision 3, engineer R. Voss.

Amber Static was tracked at 128 BPM in 4/4 time. Amber Static sits in the key of A minor. Amber Static was captured at a sample rate of 48 kHz. Amber Static was tracked at a bit depth of 24 bit. For the streaming release, Amber Static is mastered to -14 LUFS. For the club release, Amber Static is mastered to -8 LUFS.

Glass Tide is written in 7/8 time. The tempo of Glass Tide runs 92-96 BPM across the bridge section. Glass Tide settles in the key of F# minor. Glass Tide was captured at a sample rate of 96 kHz. The multitrack session for Glass Tide spans 42 tracks.

Low Orbit uses a high-pass filter set at 80 Hz. The final take of Low Orbit runs 4:37 before the fade.

Paper Lanterns clocks in at 140 BPM. Paper Lanterns sits in the key of C major.
